profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Languages/Environments:
C#, C++, AJAX, VB.NET, ASP.NET, ADO.NET, Borland C++ Builder, Delphi, Microsoft Visual C++, COM/DCOM,  Java, JavaScript, XML, Xpath, Visual BASIC, Microsoft Access, Pascal IBM 360/370 Assembler, 6809 Assembler, Working knowledge of 80486 Assembler, MS BASIC Professional Development System,  Compumotor 4000 Robotic Language and X languages, BASIC-52 for 8052/8031 embedded controllers and 27128 EPROM programmers, Hewlett Packard Graphics Language (HPGL) and Printer Control Language, dBase IV, SQL dialects including SQL Server stored procedures. DLL programming in Visual C++, VB and Delphi, Visual Studio 2003, Visual Studio 2005, Visual Studio 2008, .Net 1.0 to .Net 3.5, Visual Source Safe, Team Foundation Server.
PCs, IBM 360/370 Mainframe, Prime, WANG, Compumotor 4000 PLC, Compaq file servers, GE Series 1 PLC, SIBEC-II Micro controller.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Providing support for core business systems and new line of business web applications for transportation and garage insurance using ASP.NET/C# and an Oracle backend. These systems use web services, user controls and Ajax, in a Microsoft Team Foundation 2008 environment that provides the business with a quote, policy and rating system. These systems are now code models for future business lines.
Currently providing design and architecting services for a C# system that serves the Motor Carrier Filing business insurance requirement. This involved calculating time lines based on the business analyst’s business requirements document, and splitting the work into team resources. The existing system was upgraded from a Visual Studio 2003 web site to a Visual Studio 2008 web application. This project has been rolled out on time and $84,000.00 under budget.
I also participated in a team effort to provide a validation process that verifies production data between Oracle and Sql Server for reporting services and month end tie outs.

positions.title: Software Architect / Web Developer / Part Owner
positions.description: The Virginia Review was established in 1923 as a glossy magazine and exists today as an online magazine. We recently moved the site’s domain and configured the site for future upgrades and newer technologies. I designed and implemented a marketing tool in ASP.NET/C# that allows the sales staff to show the potential customer’s there advertisement via the online magazine. We offer ongoing support and new development for the evolving site and are continuously adding new ideas and technology to the fast growing online magazine.

positions.title: Senior .NET Developer
positions.description:
Project: Delphi to C# ASP web site conversion
This project was performed off-site and involved converting an existing Delphi desktop application to an ASP .NET web site. The system tracked the scoring of musical and performance events around the country and provided data entry for tracking schools, judges, scoring, location information and event tracking. In this project, I converted an existing Paradox database to Sql Server tables that interfaced to the company's core database. By design, the converted web application eliminated a data synchronization problem present in the previous system. The converted C# web application utilized a master / content page design, style sheets and AJAX.

positions.title: Senior Web Developer
positions.description:
Project: Personal Effectiveness Planning System
Completed a C# ASP.NET internal web system that tracks employee performance through the company’s enterprise portal system (BEA / Plumtree Portal). Personal Effectiveness Plan enables supervisors to evaluate employee performance, to set goals and plan for effective employee performance. The system was designed to set measure performance goals, objectives and accountabilities for the employee and was rated with an internal rating system. The system also calculated communication skills, teamwork, trust, innovation, recognition, and growth. The system linked the manager to all of his or her direct reports and allows the manager to drill down into each employee’s performance data. The system used Microsoft’s Enterprise Library to access Sql Server for the data access layer and a custom database logger for security and error tracking. The PEP system was built with an administrative management layer for users with administrative privileges to administer system statuses, logs, and direct reports. Reporting was developed with a custom pdf library (ASPPDFLib) that was dynamically built on the fly. Managers could upload and store any type of document to append to the performance review and retrieve (download) the documents along with the individual’s performance evaluation.  The system went into production on time with zero defects.
Project: Category Management Pre-Analysis System
This system, written in VB.NET and Ajax, was designed to analyze Swedish Match North American store sales data and compare the results to competitor stores in a given location. Utilizing geo-coding and MapQuest, sales personnel could quickly zero in on concentrated store locations and compare the area with competitor stores. Through this web application, the sales personnel could pick main chain locations and compare the store with up to 4 competitor chains. The data was then submitted to a back-end process to generate PowerPoint sales presentation

positions.title: Systems Developer
positions.description:
Developed a tracking system for the city’s fleet of vehicles in C# ASP.NET / Ajax. This system queried the city’s DB2 mainframe data via a C# web service and tracked the maintenance of the City of Richmond’s fleet of vehicles in a Sql Server database. This project involved meeting with the business users to gather business requirements for system design.
		
I was involved in a team project that tracked meetings, dockets, papers and voting for the Mayor’s administration functions. This was a C# ASP.NET web application that used web services Ajax and Sql Server. This system utilized the Model, View, Presenter (MVP) object oriented design / pattern, separating the system into logical code layers.

Both systems retrieved data via Service Oriented Architecture (SOA) that was written in C#.

company.name: The City of Richmond - Department of Information Technology

positions.title: SunTrust Bank
positions.description:
Enhanced an existing VB.NET application that generates letters to potential loan applicants. This application utilized main frame data that was ported to a Sql Server database and transformed into letters to be mailed to loan applicants. This project involved creating Sql Server tables, stored procedures, re-structuring of existing tables and writing code to transform the data.

Developed and integrated web based reports for the research request division using VB.NET; Sql Server stored procedures and JavaScript

positions.title: .Net Web Developer
positions.description:
Gathered business requirements and developed a permission based VB.NET web administration application for internal management of Markel’s portal web based systems. This system permitted administrators in the US, Canada and Europe to add, delete and modify access to core business systems. The system consisted of a web based front end that connected to a web service back end that managed the requests and stored the information in a Sql Server data base via stored procedures. Created and published all operating documentation for this system.
The system used custom defined content templates that were designed with an in house editor for the specific line of business then, stored in a database as data islands. The html / xml data was presented to underwriters and agents via a network of SOAP web services JavaScript and sever side code logic. The data islands were combined as a hybrid dictionary and queried using xpath. The data was then assimilated as single html web page. The page content was branded with XSLT and CSS script as required by the various companies and lines of business. The input data was validated with schematron business rules.  We designed the quote letters as PDF form templates that were populated with the xml data and presented as a printable web document.
Designed and implemented a VB.NET web site to handle a new outbreak insurance line of business. The web site created ‘what if’ scenarios as an indication for outbreak insurance premiums. The tool calculated all of the rating information and presented the results to the end user. The application had an option to pre populate an email to forward the results to other business units. This tool is expected to be used throughout Markel’s North Americas regions

positions.title: Senior Systems Analyst
positions.description:
Developed a system for Risk Management to monitor fraudulent activity based on the department’s investigative findings. This application was implemented as both a desktop application written in C++ and a web application written in Java and later ASP.NET using C#. 
Designed, coded and implemented a credit retrieval system. The credit system provided credit information to various software clients including an in house automated underwriting system and the company’s main loan originating system. The middle-ware was coded in C++ and is where the central processing occurred including database retrieval and communications to external credit services. The system utilized an http request-response protocol using xml as a common client language. The credit system was a multi threaded, n-tier technology, allowing simultaneous servicing of requests. 
Designed, coded an implemented a real time, multi-threaded, n-tier fraud detection system that identified fraudulent loan information. This system interfaced with AppIntelligence DISSCO systems providing loan fraud detection from 400+ databases in an average of 6 to 9 seconds. This system was built of the same technological concept as the credit system using an http request-response and xml. The fraud detection system consisted of a desktop application that interfaced to the middle ware, where all communications and processing took place in a single transaction. The information was then stored into a Microsoft SQL Server database for decision making, tracking and trend analysis

positions.title: Programmer / Analyst
positions.description: Developed client-server software using Visual Basic as a front-end client and EDA/SQL as a back end server to access DB2 database tables. This client-server technology provided an SQL interface to quality assurance data. Provided technical support including PC software, hardware and training throughout the operations and manufacturing centers. Developed a work order system for PC support and equipment orders using Visual Basic and Multi Link/VB.

positions.title: Computer Systems Engineer / Systems Design Manager
positions.description:
Coordinated all computing affairs including the following:
Designed and programmed a robotic thermal spraying machine for DenSys, a daughter company, utilizing servo and stepper technologies. A Compumotor 4000 Programmable Logic Controller, a GE Series 1 PLC and an 80386 PC, controlled the system. Designed and implemented all embedded system code for PLC.
Managed field technicians and personnel on quality control methods in paper and power companies in the US, Canada, and Europe. Frequently traveled to Europe, Canada and throughout the US to train employees, monitor jobs and install systems. Developed a quality control software package, (S.E.E.), to monitor coating thickness levels for Fortune 500 clientele
